_comment: FRESH held-out attack set v3 (Wave C) — the output of a CLOSED-LOOP adversarial search (scripts/closed-loop-mutate.mjs): round 1 mutates the malicious cores, every later round mutates only the chains that EVADED the previous round, so the set carries COMPOSED evasions a one-shot generator never reaches. Validity is mechanical, not asserted: every sample here was rendered and then rendered BACKWARDS, and the recovered plaintext had to equal its malicious core character for character (`validity: round-trip`); the single lossy axis (`typo`) is bounded to word-wise edit distance 1 (`validity: edit-bounded`). CAVEAT — `stratum: loop-survivor` samples were SELECTED against the engine as it stood when the loop ran, so recall on that stratum is a worst case, not an unbiased estimate; `loop-caught` is the control stratum. To blunt the overfit, the search ran on SEARCH_CORES and every sample here is built from HOLDOUT_CORES, which the search never saw — a surviving chain had to TRANSFER to an unseen payload. Zero exact-text overlap with corpus.json, heldout.json and heldout-v2-tune.json (verified at emission).
